title: What Is Nodics?
readerIntent: Understand what Nodics is, which problems it solves, and where to continue.
priorKnowledge: No Nodics or enterprise-framework knowledge is required.
summary: Nodics is a modular enterprise application platform and application factory for building secure, governed, API-driven, and multi-tenant business products.

sections.heading: Nodics in plain language
paragraphs: Nodics gives a team a governed starting point for APIs, data models, users, permissions, configuration, jobs, events, workflows, imports, exports, caching, search, content, commerce, testing, and runtime operations.
A beginner does not need to memorize the repository. Start with the business capability, learn its contract, and use the documented extension path.

sections.heading: The problem it solves
items: Keeps business behavior with a clear capability owner.
Prevents customer customization from being mixed into reusable framework code.
Makes security, tenant isolation, testing, observability, and documentation part of implementation.
Lets consolidated local execution evolve into modular runtime deployment.
Gives human developers and AI tools the same ownership and verification rules.

sections.heading: The core principle
paragraphs: Capabilities are sacred; implementations are negotiable.
Nodics preserves what an application can do while allowing a project to replace or extend how the capability is implemented through governed layers and providers.
